contracts.docstring: Locate bounded internal failure frames and causes without logging messages, paths, source lines or locals.
Own native attempts and grant-bound tool closure before durable terminal states.
Persist a safe, actionable owner explanation for this original run.
Own one admitted native turn, then prove peer/tool closure before finalizing it.
Keep inference uncertainty separate from the independently observed closure of the original peers.
An actual empty kernel domain can close after preparation fails, without implying unknown inference or replaying admission.
Fail before any peer is launched, retaining private error text only in memory.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. New frontend modules and exported behavior have English JSDoc; this Python audit does not certify all historical definitions.
